snippet.title: Late Night Shift Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You play as Tony, a worker covering the late shift at a remote gas station. Arriving late, you take over from your coworker, Mike, and begin your routine tasks. Everything seems normal—until it isn't. As the night unfolds, strange encounters, eerie customers, and an unknown presence lurking in the darkness turn your shift into a fight for survival.

I apologize for the delay of the official trailer for Late Night Shift. This footage was completed and rendered eight months ago, concurrent with the game's initial launch. However, as a solo developer, I faced significant unforeseen logistical and file management problems that regrettably caused the release hold.

I have now resolved these issues to ensure the original, uncut version of the trailer is finally available, making the official documentation of the incident complete.

This is a small step to finalize the record. Know that a brand-new official announcement is coming very, very soon.

The saga has just begun.
